newsitem.title: USA: Sara Lee taps McMillan and Franceschini.
newsitem.headline: Sara Lee taps McMillan and Franceschini.

text.p: Sara Lee Corp said Thursday it has promoted C. Steven McMillan to the position of president and Donald Franceschini to the position of vice chairman, effective immediately.

McMillan was formerly executive vice president of Sara Lee's Meats and Bakery, Coffee and Grocery, and Household and Body Care lines of business, and Franceschini was executive vice president of the Personal Products business.
Both McMillan and Franceschini report to Chairman of the Board and Chief Executive Officer John Bryan and serve on the company's board of directors, the company said in a statement.
Bryan, 60, has been chairman of Sara Lee since 1976, the same year that McMillan, 50, joined the company.
"These promotions represent our desire to begin an orderly transition -- for both the short-term and long-term management of Sara Lee Corporation," Bryan said in a statement.
Franceschini, 61, has said he planned to retire within the next two years, leaving McMillan as Bryan's likely successor, company spokeswoman Theresa Herlevsen said.

"Each of these individuals has demonstrated exceptional leadership and management capabilities," Bryan's statement said. "Their promotions today reflect my confidence in the management team that will join me in leading Sara Lee Corporation into the next century."
The post of president at Sara Lee had been vacant for about three years since the resignation of Cornelias Boonstra, an executive from one of the company's European subsidiaries.
McMillan has shone as the executive in charge of Sara Lee's expanding meats, bakery, foodservice and body care product lines. "All these businesses have performed very well," Herlevsen said.
McMillan will continue with his current operating responsibilities, and will be involved in the strategic direction of all of the corporation's businesses, the company said.

The board of directors also promoted senior vice presdent Frank Meysman to the post of executive vice president. Meysman, based in Utrecht, the Netherlands, serves as chairman of the board of management of Sara Lee/DE. He will report to McMillan.
